description: This file contains UI utility functions for the Unvanquished game, including event handling, icon generation, circle menu layout, and welcome message logic.

methods.name: detectEscape
methods.description: Handles escape key event to hide menus or documents.

methods.name: RightClickClose
methods.description: Closes circle menus on right click.

methods.name: AvailabilityIcon
methods.description: Returns icon HTML based on availability status.

methods.name: CirclemenuSkeleton
methods.description: Generates HTML for a circular menu layout with specified number of items.

methods.name: CirclemenuKeyboardHints
methods.description: Generates HTML for keyboard hints around a circle.

methods.name: CirclemenuHandleKey
methods.description: Handles key events for circle menu selection.

methods.name: CloseOtherCirclemenus
methods.description: Closes all other circle menus except the current one.

methods.name: welcome
methods.description: Displays a welcome message and sets a default player name if needed.
